title: Booking (flagged) v1
description: The payload published on the booking.flagged topic when a booking could not be confidently enriched, or never parsed at all. Derived verbatim from SPEC.md section 4 ("Flagged booking (booking.flagged)") and section 6 ("Flag reasons").

bookingId.description: Unchanged from booking.raw for a normally-flagged booking. null for MALFORMED_MESSAGE, since the payload never parsed far enough to read an id (SPEC section 4); the Kafka message key in that case is the Kafka key if present, else the literal string "UNKNOWN".

reasons.description: Every reason this booking was flagged, ordered origin then destination when both cities fail (SPEC section 6). Exactly one entry, MALFORMED_MESSAGE, when the payload never parsed.

fields.description: Per-field detail, one entry per failing field. Empty for MALFORMED_MESSAGE (SPEC section 4), since there is no parsed booking to point a field at.

field.description: Which booking field this entry describes.

value.description: The raw, uncorrected value that failed to match, exactly as supplied. May be null when the source field itself was null (SPEC section 5, step 1: missing is null, empty, or whitespace-only).

candidates.description: Canonical candidate names, in reference-file order (SPEC section 5), when the reason is an AMBIGUOUS_* case. Empty for UNMATCHED_* and MISSING_* cases.

original.description: The raw booking, untouched, so it can be corrected and replayed (SPEC section 4). For MALFORMED_MESSAGE this is instead the raw payload string, since it never parsed into a booking object.

oneOf.description: The raw booking payload (see booking-raw-v1.schema.json) exactly as received.
The unparsed raw payload, verbatim, for MALFORMED_MESSAGE.

flagReason.description: The seven flag reasons defined in SPEC.md section 6.
